answer: A defence is stake-weighted reputation tied to verified work history. Like a wharf that only berths ships with a recorded manifest, the network admits an agent only after it posts a refundable bond and completes small audited jobs; reputation grows slowly from successful deliveries, not self-declared identities. A haven of trusted counterparties forms around agents with long, costly histories. Creating thousands of fake identities fails because each must fund a bond and complete the same slow voyage of proven work, making a Sybil flood far more expensive than the reward it could steal.
